sensitivity_history.numerical_repair_method: All 55 planned probes have recorded dispositions: 54 usable sensitivity fits and 1 computationally unresolved case(s). They required 58 sampler calls, including 4 retained failures. The pre-2007 NCEI linear fit succeeded after its separately reviewed repair using 2,000 tuning steps and target_accept=0.99. Both attempts for the 2014-onward linear fit failed diagnostics; no third attempt is permitted. The curved 2014-onward first attempt also failed; its one final numerical attempt used 4,000 tuning steps and target_accept=0.999. The first attempts of original cases37..54 and the unsuccessful second linear attempt used 2,000 tuning steps and target_accept=0.99. All numerical attempts retain four chains and 2,000 retained draws. Original models, priors, masks, cohorts and seeds are unchanged. These are not independent repeat experiments. Predictive summaries retain original seed + 1 and 800 draws. Failed outputs contribute no posterior draws to the 68 usable report views. Accepted-case summaries rely on independent scientific review and fresh complete producer bytes; the 14 historical reference summaries are recomputed. No native data were changed or imputed.
sensitivity_history.unresolved_comparison: The NCEI linear 2014-onward sensitivity remains computationally unresolved after two failed attempts. Its original run had 30 divergences; the reviewed numerical attempt retained one divergence among 8,000 draws and failed the unchanged zero-divergence screen. No third attempt is authorized. Neither attempt supplies posterior parameters, curves or predictive checks. This leaves a gap in the linear-model stress checks: the available results cannot establish robustness for this comparison or be used to favor curvature. Its 150 original observations remain in the other applicable fits and full-data analyses; this disposition deletes no data. The curved 2014-onward fit became usable only after its final numerical repair. Its availability does not resolve the missing linear comparison or establish an era advantage.
